aha: You cannot get past the piranha; it circles a short pit under the side shaft. Push the stone down the shaft as it swims underneath, then dig through the sand plug and bring the pearl along the tunnel.
deadlocks: Pushing the stone down the shaft while the piranha is elsewhere: the stone lands in the pit, the piranha lives on and blocks the tunnel.
Digging the sand plug (or opening the pearl plug) while the piranha is alive: it charges along the clear row.
timing: stone drop kill window 17% -> 44% (piranha pit shortened to 3 cells + shaft, plug of sand at x=5..7); safe wait at (4,3)
